lines.text: Build a month-by-month home maintenance plan around weather, equipment instructions and last-done dates, with safe limits for DIY work.

items.text: List the systems actually present, including any septic, well, sump pump, fireplace or irrigation.
Collect manuals and service records before assigning intervals.
Add local freeze, heavy-rain, heat and storm periods.
Separate safe owner observations from professional maintenance.
For each planned task, record last done, next trigger and who is responsible.
Schedule a short monthly review and leave room for a newly discovered problem.

line.text: It holds the timing for you and raises a job when it is worth doing, then goes quiet again. Nothing sits on screen permanently.
